section: Social security and DBT - PM-JDY, JAM trinity, Aadhaar-enabled transfers, pension schemes

accepted.s: Which Department is responsible for implementing the Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana?
o: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
accepted.x: The Department of Financial Services implements the Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana.
accepted.tq: Identify the ministry or department that performs the implementation function.

accepted.s: Which one of the following is a basic feature of an account opened under the Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana?
accepted.x: PMJDY provides basic bank accounts that can be maintained without a minimum balance.
accepted.tq: Distinguish an inclusion-oriented feature from restrictive banking conditions.

accepted.s:
With reference to the Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana, consider the following statements:
1. The RuPay debit card carries accident insurance cover of ₹2 lakh.
2. The overdraft facility has been raised to ₹10,000.
3. The accident insurance cover was originally ₹5 lakh.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The RuPay card accident cover was raised from ₹1 lakh to ₹2 lakh, and the overdraft limit was raised from ₹5,000 to ₹10,000. Statement 3 is false because the original cover was ₹1 lakh.
accepted.tq: Split the statements by checking the revised figures against the original figures.

accepted.s: After 14 August 2018, the focus of the Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana shifted from:
o: Rural households to urban households only
Every unbanked adult to every household
Every household to every unbanked adult
accepted.x: The focus changed from covering every household to covering every unbanked adult.
accepted.tq: Test the direction of change in a policy target rather than merely recalling both terms.

accepted.s:
Which of the following was included in Phase II of the Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana during 2015–2018?
1. Overdraft facility
2. Credit Guarantee Fund for overdraft defaults
3. Unorganised-sector pensions under Swavalamban
4. Replacement of RuPay cards by credit cards
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Phase II included the overdraft facility, a Credit Guarantee Fund for overdraft defaults and unorganised-sector pensions under Swavalamban. Replacement of RuPay cards by credit cards was not a stated feature.
accepted.tq: Find the one unrelated policy measure among closely connected programme features.

accepted.s: As on 19 August 2026, which one of the following correctly represents the number of PMJDY accounts and the number of rural and semi-urban accounts respectively?
accepted.x: PMJDY had 59.09 crore accounts, of which 45.95 crore were in rural and semi-urban areas as on 19 August 2026.
accepted.tq: Match the total with its corresponding geographical sub-total.

accepted.s: Which pair correctly represents the PMJDY figures reported as on 19 August 2026?
o: Women account holders—32.92 crore; deposits—₹3,16,514 crore
Women account holders—45.95 crore; deposits—₹2,30,226 crore
Women account holders—32.92 crore; deposits—₹15,670 crore
Women account holders—59.09 crore; deposits—₹3,16,514 crore
accepted.x: The number of women account holders was 32.92 crore and deposits amounted to ₹3,16,514 crore.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure numerical pair and reject combinations using the total or sub-total figures.

accepted.s: The deposits under PMJDY increased approximately how many times between March 2015 and 19 August 2026?
accepted.x: Deposits increased from ₹15,670 crore in March 2015 to ₹3,16,514 crore, approximately a twenty-fold increase.
accepted.tq: Estimate the order of magnitude from the initial and final figures.

accepted.s: The National Social Assistance Programme was launched in 1995 under the:
o: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
accepted.x: NSAP was launched in 1995 under the Ministry of Rural Development.
accepted.tq: Use the implementing ministry as the identifying feature of the programme.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the National Social Assistance Programme:
1. It is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme.
2. It fulfils the directive contained in Article 41 of the Constitution.
3. It is intended for Below Poverty Line households.
4. It became a Core of Core scheme from 2016.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: NSAP is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme for BPL households, fulfils Article 41 and has been a Core of Core scheme since 2016.
accepted.tq: When all statements describe separate institutional features, test whether the complete combination is valid.

accepted.s: Under the Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme, the monthly central assistance is:
o: ₹200 for 60–79 years and ₹300 for 80 years and above
₹500 for 60–79 years and ₹1,000 for 80 years and above
₹200 for 60–79 years and ₹500 for 80 years and above
₹300 for 60–79 years and ₹500 for 80 years and above
accepted.x: IGNOAPS provides ₹200 per month to persons aged 60–79 years and ₹500 per month to those aged 80 years and above.
accepted.tq: Compare the age bands before selecting the corresponding benefit.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly states the assistance under the Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme?
o: ₹300 per month to widows aged 40–79 years and ₹500 to those aged 80 years and above
₹500 per month to widows aged 40–79 years and ₹300 to those aged 80 years and above
₹300 per month to all widows irrespective of age
₹200 per month to widows aged 40–79 years and ₹500 to those aged 80 years and above
accepted.x: IGNWPS provides ₹300 per month to widows aged 40–79 years and ₹500 per month to widows aged 80 years and above.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the widow-pension amount from the old-age-pension amount for the same age group.

accepted.s: The Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme provides which of the following assistance?
o: ₹300 per month to severely disabled persons belonging to BPL households
A lump-sum payment on the death of the primary breadwinner
₹500 per month to all disabled persons irrespective of economic status
₹200 per month to all persons with disabilities
accepted.x: IGNDPS provides ₹300 per month to severely disabled persons from BPL households.
accepted.tq: Separate a regular pension benefit from a death-related lump-sum benefit.

accepted.s: The National Family Benefit Scheme under NSAP provides:
o: An overdraft facility to BPL households
A monthly pension to widows aged 40–79 years
A lump-sum benefit on the death of the primary breadwinner
accepted.x: NFBS provides a lump-sum benefit when the primary breadwinner of the household dies.
accepted.tq: Identify the event triggering the benefit rather than the beneficiary category alone.

accepted.s: Under the Annapurna scheme, free foodgrains are provided to:
o: Needy elderly persons who are not receiving IGNOAPS
All households affected by the death of a breadwinner
All rural households without bank accounts
accepted.x: Annapurna provides free foodgrains to needy elderly persons who do not receive IGNOAPS.
accepted.tq: Look for the eligibility exception attached to an existing pension scheme.

accepted.s: The quantity of foodgrains provided monthly under the Annapurna scheme is:
accepted.x: The Annapurna scheme provides 10 kg of foodgrains per month to eligible needy elderly persons.
accepted.tq: Select the exact quantity from the scheme-specific benefit figures.

accepted.s: The National Maternity Benefit Scheme was transferred to the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare in:
accepted.x: The National Maternity Benefit Scheme was moved to the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare in 2001.
accepted.tq: Link an administrative transfer with its precise year.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the recent National Social Assistance Programme figures?
o: About 2.09 crore beneficiaries and ₹6,952 crore for 2025–26
About 3.09 crore beneficiaries and ₹3,16,514 crore for 2025–26
About 3.09 crore beneficiaries and ₹9,652 crore for 2025–26
About 9.65 crore beneficiaries and ₹3,09,000 crore for 2025–26
accepted.x: The programme had about 3.09 crore beneficiaries and an allocation or expenditure figure of ₹9,652 crore for FY 2025–26.
accepted.tq: Match the beneficiary count with the associated financial figure.

accepted.s: States provide top-ups under NSAP in the range of approximately:
accepted.x: State governments provide additional assistance ranging from ₹50 to ₹3,200 per month.
accepted.tq: Check both endpoints of the stated range and its time unit.

accepted.s: The Unorganised Workers’ Social Security Act was enacted in:
accepted.x: The Unorganised Workers’ Social Security Act was enacted in 2008 and has subsequently been subsumed in the Code on Social Security, 2020.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the original enactment year from the later consolidating code.

accepted.s: The Code on Social Security, 2020 is significant because it:
o: Subsumed the Unorganised Workers’ Social Security Act, 2008
Transferred all social-security functions to State governments
Replaced two labour laws with one social-security scheme
accepted.x: The Unorganised Workers’ Social Security Act, 2008 was subsumed in the Code on Social Security, 2020.
accepted.tq: Identify the precise legal relationship between an earlier Act and a later code.

accepted.s: The Code on Social Security, 2020 is one of the four labour codes that replaced:
accepted.x: The four labour codes collectively replaced 29 earlier labour laws.
accepted.tq: Use the distinctive aggregate figure associated with a legislative consolidation.

accepted.s: The Employees’ Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952 generally applies to establishments employing:
accepted.x: The EPF and MP Act, 1952 applies to establishments with 20 or more employees.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the statutory coverage threshold from nearby employment cut-offs.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly represents the coverage of the Employees’ State Insurance system as on 31 March 2025?
o: 695 districts, 4.09 crore employees and 15.87 crore people
695 districts, 15.87 crore employees and 4.09 crore people
409 districts, 6.95 crore employees and 15.87 crore people
695 districts, 4.09 lakh employees and 1.587 crore people
accepted.x: ESI covered 695 districts, 4.09 crore employees and 15.87 crore people as on 31 March 2025.
accepted.tq: Keep the geographical, employee and population figures in their correct order.

accepted.s: India’s social protection coverage rose from 22 per cent in 2016 to what level in 2025?
accepted.x: Social protection coverage increased to 64.3 per cent in 2025 from 22 per cent in 2016.
accepted.tq: Test the trend and the final value together rather than either percentage alone.

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT included among the beneficiaries of NTR Bharosa Pension in Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: NTR Bharosa Pension covers elderly persons, widows, single women, weavers, fishermen and artisans; it is not a universal pension for all formal-sector employees above 18 years.
accepted.tq: Find the category that falls outside the stated beneficiary groups.

accepted.s: NTR Bharosa Pension was earlier known as:
o: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
accepted.x: NTR Bharosa Pension was earlier known as YSR Pension Kanuka.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between similarly named Andhra Pradesh welfare programmes.

accepted.s: The monthly pension under NTR Bharosa Pension ranges approximately from:
accepted.x: NTR Bharosa Pension provides monthly pensions ranging from ₹4,000 to ₹15,000 to eligible beneficiaries.
accepted.tq: Select the correct lower and upper limits of the benefit range.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly represents the December 2024 NTR Bharosa Pension disbursement in Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: In December 2024, 63,77,943 pensioners received ₹2,717.32 crore under the reported disbursement.
accepted.tq: Match the beneficiary count with its corresponding disbursement amount.

accepted.s: Which statement regarding Andhra Pradesh’s role in NSAP financing is correct?
o: The State tops up NSAP assistance from its own funds.
The State does not contribute any funds beyond the central assistance.
The State has transferred NSAP financing entirely to local bodies.
The State provides top-ups only for urban beneficiaries.
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh supplements the central NSAP assistance through top-ups from its own funds.
accepted.tq: Identify the additional fiscal role played by the State government.

accepted.s: From January 2026, pension distribution under the Andhra Pradesh system was automated using:
accepted.x: From January 2026, real-time Aadhaar biometric verification was introduced to automate distribution and remove ghost beneficiaries.
accepted.tq: Match the administrative objective of eliminating ghosts with the appropriate verification technology.

accepted.s: The PMJDY completed 12 years in:
accepted.x: PMJDY completed 12 years in August 2026, when it had 59.09 crore accounts.
accepted.tq: Calculate the programme milestone from its stated anniversary year.

accepted.s: Which of the following is a major criticism concerning the old-age pension under NSAP?
o: Its real value has remained unchanged despite inflation.
Its real value has nearly doubled because of inflation.
Its real value has been reduced by nearly half because of inflation.
It has been converted entirely into a foodgrain benefit.
accepted.x: Inflation has eroded nearly half of the real value of the NSAP old-age pension.
accepted.tq: Distinguish nominal assistance from its inflation-adjusted real value.

accepted.s: The controversy in Kerala regarding pension delivery primarily concerned the choice between:
o: Bank accounts and postal savings certificates
DBT and doorstep delivery for elderly beneficiaries
accepted.x: Kerala’s decision to end doorstep pension delivery for DBT led to protests, highlighting the tension between digital transfers and doorstep delivery for the elderly.
accepted.tq: Identify the two alternative delivery mechanisms at the centre of the policy debate.

accepted.s: Approximately how many people escaped multidimensional poverty in India over the decade referred to in recent assessments?
accepted.x: An estimated 24.8 crore people escaped multidimensional poverty over the decade.
accepted.tq: Pay attention to the crore scale and the placement of the decimal.

accepted.s: India’s elderly population share is projected to rise from 10.1 per cent in 2021 to what level by 2036?
accepted.x: The elderly population share is projected to increase from 10.1 per cent in 2021 to 14.9 per cent in 2036, increasing the need for pensions.
accepted.tq: Compare the base-year share with the projected demographic share.
